scenarios.title: A｜转账失败
scenarios.setting: 玩家尝试通过银行 App 转账，但交易没有成功。

turns.text: Hi. I’m having trouble making a bank transfer.
What happens when you try to send the money?

turns.prompt: 关于「转账」，你想说明遇到的问题或处理后的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: The transfer keeps failing.

feedback.naturalExpression: The transfer keeps failing.
feedback.explanation: “keeps failing”说明操作反复失败，区别于偶尔一次出错。

choices.text: I tried several times, but it won’t go through.

feedback.naturalExpression: I tried several times, but it won’t go through.
feedback.explanation: 先交代一部分情况，再补充限制或不同之处，避免对方只根据前半句作判断。

choices.text: I get an error message every time I try to send it.

feedback.naturalExpression: I get an error message every time I try to send it.
feedback.explanation: “error message”指报错提示；说明出现在哪一步，有助于对方排查。

choices.text: The app says the transfer can’t be completed.

feedback.naturalExpression: The app says the transfer can’t be completed.
feedback.explanation: “can’t be completed”用被动结构表示操作无法完成，适合转述系统提示。

choices.text: My transfer can’t success.

feedback.naturalExpression: The transfer keeps failing.
feedback.explanation: “success”是名词，“successful”是形容词，不能直接跟在“didn’t / can’t”后作动词；这里可说“didn’t go through”。

turns.text: Has any money been deducted from your account?

turns.prompt: 你想说明转账失败后账户余额的情况，会怎么说？

choices.text: No, my balance hasn’t changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, my balance hasn’t changed.
feedback.explanation: “hasn’t”与过去分词搭配说明截至现在仍未完成的事，方便对方判断当前进度。

choices.text: I don’t think so. Let me check.

feedback.naturalExpression: I don’t think so. Let me check.
feedback.explanation: “I don’t think”把不同意见表达为自己的判断，而不是直接断定对方错误。

choices.text: Yes, the money was deducted, but the transfer shows as failed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, the money was deducted, but the transfer shows as failed.
feedback.explanation: 转折后的内容说明当前需要注意的不同情况，能把顾虑或限制说清楚。

choices.text: It shows as pending, so I’m not sure whether it went through.

feedback.naturalExpression: It shows as pending, so I’m not sure whether it went through.
feedback.explanation: 明确表达不确定，让对方知道需要进一步确认，而不是把猜测当作事实。

turns.text: Did you double-check the recipient’s details?

turns.prompt: 你想确认信息或告诉对方已经完成，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes. The account details are correct.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. The account details are correct.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

choices.text: I’ll check them again now.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’ll check them again now.
feedback.explanation: “will”在这里交代接下来的决定或行动，让对方知道自己会怎样继续。

choices.text: Could the transfer have been blocked for another reason?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could the transfer have been blocked for another reason?
feedback.explanation: 把需要的行动明确说出来，并用礼貌用语缓和请求；对方能直接回应能否做到。

choices.text: Is there a limit on how much I can transfer?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a limit on how much I can transfer?
feedback.explanation: “How much”可问金额或不可数事物的量；这里把所需数额直接作为问题重点。

turns.text: Let me check the transaction for you.

turns.prompt: 关于「转账」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: Thanks. I’d like to know whether I should try again.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks. I’d like to know whether I should try again.
feedback.explanation: “would like”清楚表达需求，语气比直接说“want”更委婉，适合提出请求或表达偏好。

choices.text: Okay. I just don’t want to accidentally send the money twice.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I just don’t want to accidentally send the money twice.
feedback.explanation: 明确说明哪件事没有发生或无法进行，把问题落在具体动作上。

scenarios.title: B｜退款未到账
scenarios.setting: 商家告诉玩家已经退款，但过了一段时间账户里仍然没有收到。

turns.text: Hi. I’m waiting for a refund that hasn’t shown up in my account yet.

turns.prompt: 你想补充商家办理退款的时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: The store said they issued it five days ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: The store said they issued it five days ago.
feedback.explanation: “issued it”表示已经发出或办理该项内容，可用于转述商家对处理进度的说明。

choices.text: I was told the refund was processed last week.

feedback.naturalExpression: I was told the refund was processed last week.
feedback.explanation: “was told”表示这是此前被告知的信息；交代来源，有助于核对不同说法。

choices.text: The merchant says they’ve already sent the money back.

feedback.naturalExpression: The merchant says they’ve already sent the money back.
feedback.explanation: “already”强调事情已经发生或完成，适合核对进度与时间先后。

choices.text: I’m not sure of the exact date, but I have the refund confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not sure of the exact date, but I have the refund confirmation.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: The shop returned my money, but I didn’t receive it.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: The store said they issued it five days ago.
feedback.explanation: “returned my money”已经像钱退到了手里；商家说已退款但未到账，可说“The refund hasn’t shown up”。

turns.text: Do you have any confirmation from the merchant?

turns.prompt: 你想了解退换或退款的处理办法，会怎么说？

choices.text: Yes, I have an email confirming the refund.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes, I have an email confirming the refund.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Yes. I can provide the refund reference number.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yes. I can provide the refund reference number.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: I have a screenshot of the confirmation.

feedback.naturalExpression: I have a screenshot of the confirmation.
feedback.explanation: 交代与当前有关的经历或已完成的事，让对方了解这次沟通的背景。

choices.text: No, they only told me verbally.

feedback.naturalExpression: No, they only told me verbally.
feedback.explanation: 先直接肯定或否定，再补充细节；对方能先听清结论，再理解具体情况。

turns.text: Sometimes refunds take several business days to appear.

turns.prompt: 你想了解时间安排或需要等多久，会怎么问？

choices.text: How long should I wait before contacting you again?

feedback.naturalExpression: How long should I wait before contacting you again?
feedback.explanation: “How long”询问持续时长，而不是具体几点。

choices.text: Can you see whether the refund is pending?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can you see whether the refund is pending?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Is there any way to trace the refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there any way to trace the refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Should I contact the merchant again as well?

feedback.naturalExpression: Should I contact the merchant again as well?
feedback.explanation: “as well”表示也、还，常用于在已有事项上补充另一项需求。

scenarios.title: C｜联系客服查询
scenarios.setting: 在“转账 / 退款问题”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“联系客服查询”。

turns.prompt: 关于「转账」，你想让对方了解你的需求或来意，会怎么说明？

choices.text: I’d like to check the status of a transaction.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to check the status of a transaction.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I’m calling about a transfer I made a few days ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m calling about a transfer I made a few days ago.
feedback.explanation: 开头就交代来访或来电目的，帮助对方判断该查询什么、由谁处理。

choices.text: Could you help me find out what’s happening with a refund?

feedback.naturalExpression: Could you help me find out what’s happening with a refund?
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: There’s a transaction showing as pending, and I’d like to know why.

feedback.naturalExpression: There’s a transaction showing as pending, and I’d like to know why.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

choices.text: I want to ask where my money is.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: I’d like to check the status of a transaction.
feedback.explanation: “where my money is”容易听成质问；说明是哪笔退款或转账，再问处理状态，更方便查询。

turns.text: Can you give me the date and amount of the transaction?

turns.prompt: 你想提供待查询交易的时间和金额，会怎么说？

choices.text: It was $250 on September 3rd.

feedback.naturalExpression: It was $250 on September 3rd.
feedback.explanation: 给出金额和日期，能把待查交易与其他记录区分开。

choices.text: I sent $400 three days ago.

feedback.naturalExpression: I sent $400 three days ago.
feedback.explanation: 提供自己经历或做过的具体情况，让对方能在已知信息上继续确认。

choices.text: The refund was for $79.99, and it was issued last Monday.

feedback.naturalExpression: The refund was for $79.99, and it was issued last Monday.
feedback.explanation: “refund”指退款，指退还已支付的款项。

choices.text: Sure. I have the transaction details in front of me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Sure. I have the transaction details in front of me.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

turns.text: I found it. The transaction is still pending.

turns.prompt: 你想询问交易迟迟未完成的原因或时间，会怎么说？

choices.text: Do you know why it’s still pending?

feedback.naturalExpression: Do you know why it’s still pending?
feedback.explanation: 询问对方是否掌握所需信息，也给“不清楚”留出回答空间。

choices.text: When should it be completed?

feedback.naturalExpression: When should it be completed?
feedback.explanation: 询问时间或时机，便于对方给出具体安排，减少对等待或操作时间的猜测。

choices.text: Is there anything I need to do?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there anything I need to do?
feedback.explanation: 直接说明必要的需求，便于对方了解要解决什么；配合具体内容，比只说需要帮忙更清楚。

choices.text: Can the transaction still be canceled at this point?

feedback.naturalExpression: Can the transaction still be canceled at this point?
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。

turns.text: There’s nothing you need to do right now. If the status doesn’t change within the expected processing time, contact us again.

turns.prompt: 你想进一步确认时间，会怎么问？

choices.text: Okay. When should I contact you again if it hasn’t changed?

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. When should I contact you again if it hasn’t changed?
feedback.explanation: 征求建议或确认下一步，适合流程不熟悉时请对方指导。

choices.text: Is there a reference number I should keep?

feedback.naturalExpression: Is there a reference number I should keep?
feedback.explanation: 先确认有没有所需的物品、服务或安排，为后面的选择提供依据。

choices.text: Got it. I’ll keep an eye on the transaction. Thanks for your help.

feedback.naturalExpression: Got it. I’ll keep an eye on the transaction. Thanks for your help.
feedback.explanation: “transaction”指一笔交易，日期和金额有助于定位对应记录。
